purpose: Mint EV-AES-005 and DEC-20260802-007 from the reviewed BATCH-001 package and set the goal checkpoint.
what_this_archive_does_NOT_do: It does not mark GOAL-AES-003 completed. A declared completion criterion IS met at r=5, but closure additionally requires three CONCUR attestations with pairwise-distinct resolved model IDs, and this harness resolves every subagent to one model. No attestation was obtained and none is recorded.

It promotes no knowledge entry. DEC-20260802-007 defers promotion one batch on substance: ruling 3 makes the correct subject of the finding the AES-shaped SPN class, and the control delimiting that class did not run.
It asserts nothing about full-round or deployed AES, and no comparison to published cryptanalysis in either direction.

dispatcher_verification.why: An archive may only bind content it INTRODUCES. The review artifacts this archive would bind were already committed by Coordinator `git add -A` runs at a7d9437f and f398c0ab while the reviews were still executing, so the archive commit does not change them. Recorded in full as CORR-20260802-008.
dispatcher_verification.what_this_does_and_does_not_mean: The ledger commit exists and is pushed: EV-AES-005, DEC-20260802-007, the goal checkpoint and this receipt. What is absent is a machine stamp, not a result, and not a review.
dispatcher_verification.not_repaired_by_rewriting: Both offending commits are pushed and carry review artifacts. AGENTS.md forbids rewriting history over pushed run records; a defect in how a result was stamped does not license destroying the record of the result.
dispatcher_verification.repair: Process change in BATCH-002: while any review task is live, stage declared paths explicitly and never run `git add -A`.

DISPATCHER_VERIFICATION_STATUS.why_not: This archive is COMMITTED AND PUSHED but the dispatcher's post-commit verifier cannot accept it, so under AGENTS.md rule 7 EV-AES-005 and DEC-20260802-007 are PUBLISHED BUT NOT OFFICIAL. Two independent reasons, both structural and neither fixable retroactively without rewriting pushed history, which the same rules forbid.
DISPATCHER_VERIFICATION_STATUS.reason_1_commit_message: research_dispatch.py requires the archive commit message to name the archive task id and every record id. The message names EV-AES-005 and DEC-20260802-007 but not TASK-20260802-909.
DISPATCHER_VERIFICATION_STATUS.reason_2_exact_path_rule: The verifier requires the archive commit to change EXACTLY the archive's own artifacts plus every source task's artifacts. Source TASK-20260802-908's artifact, red_team_report.yaml, rode the earlier commit a7d9437f because the red team finished first and its findings were acted on immediately. The ledger commit therefore cannot contain it, and no later commit can put it there without re-adding an unchanged blob.
DISPATCHER_VERIFICATION_STATUS.what_is_NOT_in_doubt: The content is bound by the sha256 map above and the commit is reachable from HEAD and from origin. Nothing here is a claim that the evidence is wrong; it is a claim that the harness's own officiality gate was not passed.
DISPATCHER_VERIFICATION_STATUS.root_cause: Same class as the snapshot irregularity recorded in TASK-20260802-906: this batch ran its lifecycle out of order, with review artifacts committed as they landed rather than held for the archive commit. The dispatcher's exact-path rule assumes reviews are staged by the archive task alone.
DISPATCHER_VERIFICATION_STATUS.corrective_action: Recorded as CORR-20260802-009; BATCH-002 stages every review artifact in the ledger archive commit itself.
